verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a recruiting SaaS, but nothing in the evidence documents an on-premises or self-hosted deployment of Workable. The docs only describe the vendor-hosted service, reached at '<account subdomain>.workable.com', plus API and MCP access to that hosted platform. API access and data control are adjacent capabilities, not self-hosting, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
